scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w @cowork/shared" "npm run dev -w @cowork/api" "npm run dev -w @cowork/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @cowork/api && npm run build -w @cowork/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && tsc -p apps/api --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
